Built a generative AI assistant researchers could trust: it checks gene names against official databases and falls back to a local list of 19,213 genes if they go down (LangChain, AWS).
Led the design in a five-person team that turned a startup client's vague idea into a working AI prototype in three months; senior leadership rated it 5 stars (Python, MCP).
Built a search assistant that combines web search with a database and runs on a free local AI model, tested automatically on Python 3.9 to 3.11 (MCP, PostgreSQL).

Built scikit-learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deployed as FastAPI services in Docker.

skills.Machine Learning, Deep Learning & Statis: Machine learning concepts, statistical analysis (descriptive statistics, correlation analysis), predictive modelling (gradient boosting with XGBoost, random forest, scikit-learn), clustering (K-Means, HAC, DBSCAN, Leiden), deep learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, LSTM, BiRNN, CNN), time-series forecasting (cyclic time encoding, TimeSeriesSplit), anomaly detection (Isolation Forest), class-imbalance handling (SMOTE), hyper-parameter tuning (grid search, two-stage Bayesian), model evaluation (held-out, cross-validation, Pearson, MCC), statistical inference and experimental design (confidence intervals, bootstrap, hypothesis testing; MSc coursework), MLflow experiment tracking
skills.Python, Data Quality & Cloud: Python, pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, SQL, PostgreSQL, R (tidymodels), identifier crosswalks, parquet, reproducible pipelines, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes (AWS EKS), serverless deployment (AWS Lambda), containerisation, GitHub Actions CI/CD, FastAPI, TensorFlow Serving, pytest, Git
skills.NLP, LLMs, Embeddings & Evaluation: NLP (text preprocessing, TF-IDF, SBERT embeddings, text clustering), Hugging Face Transformers, large language models (Claude, OpenAI, open-weight via Ollama), prompt engineering, RAG with embeddings (ChromaDB), agents (LangChain, LangGraph), team LoRA fine-tune of Llama, LLM evaluation (hallucination-rate analysis, deterministic guardrails)
skills.Client Delivery & Communication: Scoping ambiguous problems with clients, stakeholder demos, working with client engineering teams, code review, transparent reporting of model limitations, root-cause analysis, technical documentation
